annotations.text: Tab 1 photo strip: in the real site this crossfades quietly (~6s) through the site photos - dolmen, aerial, and more can join the rotation. No arrows, no dots.
'The notation' opens the existing EpistemicNotationModal (#notation). 'Worked example' opens notation.html - the annotated Tuba assessment that used to be the Example tab - in a fullscreen modal.

5th tab is Q&A (muted): GitHub repository link + backup material for questions. Design Principles is HIDDEN from the tab bar but kept in the code, still reachable via the #design route if needed during Q&A. Chips on tab 2 carry short tooltips on hover.
